title: Does Increasing the Riskiness of Choices Widen Gender Gaps?
eligible_reason: Single national reform date: post_year = as.numeric(arstall >= 2014) for all NHH students/courses (data_cleaning_admin.R lines 100/123). Identification is a gender x post difference (feols(asked ~ sex1 + sex1:post_year | year [+ course_id + grade + retake])), i.e., treatment intensity differs by gender, not by adoption date; online experiment regressions are randomized-condition OLS. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: Student-course-exam administrative records from NHH, 2009-2019; regrade requests and grade changes before/after the 2014 change to the regrade system (new committee, grades can go down); year-by-gender event studies (sex1 x year_fac); structural estimation and a supplemental online experiment on willingness to pay for regrades.
data_files_note: readme_hw.txt: administrative analysis file shipped except year of birth (used only for demographics); experimental data shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Common 2014 reform; not staggered.
